tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Find listings of Venues Abroad with the filters of the site, 20 per page, most checked facts first. list_categories names the filters and values of each category.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: One listing with every fact, the page each fact comes from, and the date it was checked.

tools.name: compare_listings
tools.description: Two to five listings side by side, fact by fact.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The categories with their number of listings and their filters, each with its values.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: The places with listings and their numbers: the top level, or the places inside a parent place.
